_note: require_signature and require_sbom are false, and that is a statement of
authorization status, not a relaxation of a strict policy: A1/A2 (signing)
and A6 (SBOM) are NOT APPROVED. This repository has no signing key, no
approved signer identity, and no SBOM generator. Setting either to true
would demand evidence that cannot exist yet, which would block every
deployment and invite somebody to disable the gate.
While they are false the gate records G3.signature_required_by_policy and
G4.identity_chain_complete as NOT REQUIRED with the reason 'the identity
chain is INCOMPLETE by policy', so an unsigned image can never be reported
as a complete identity chain. Flipping either flag, choosing Rekor versus a
private Sigstore, and defining any observe-only grace period are supply-chain
